versions.content: Configuration of DTC priority as extended data record If DemInternalDataElement is set to DEM_DTC_PRIORITY , the Dem shall set the value of this internal data element to the DTC priority assigned by DemDTCPriority for this DTC. The length of this internal data element is one byte.
